# upGrad USA

> > upGrad USA offers online degree programs and professional certifications from global universities, specializing in executive education, business administration, data science, and AI for working professionals.

upGrad USA is a leading online education platform connecting US professionals with prestigious international universities for advanced degrees and certifications. The platform focuses on executive education, MBA programs, doctoral degrees, and emerging technology certifications with flexible, blended-learning formats.

## Key Topics

- Generative AI
- Doctor of Business Administration (DBA)
- Executive Education
- Machine Learning
- Chief Technology and AI Officer (CTAIO)
- Online MBA
- Data Science
- University Partnerships
- Professional Development
- Artificial Intelligence
- Business Administration
- Career Development
- Working Professionals
- Blended Learning
- US Professionals

## Doctoral & Executive Degree Programs

- [Doctor of Business Administration (DBA) Degree Online](https://www.upgrad.com/us/dba-course): DBA degree programs overview with requirements, fees, and placements
- [DBA from Golden Gate University](https://www.upgrad.com/us/doctor-of-business-administration-from-golden-gate-university-us): Golden Gate University DBA program curriculum and enrollment details
- [DBA in Emerging Technologies with Generative AI Concentration](https://www.upgrad.com/us/dba-emerging-technologies-specialization-in-gen-ai-ggu-us): Golden Gate University DBA with Generative AI specialization program
- [DBA from ESGCI](https://www.upgrad.com/us/doctor-of-business-administration-from-esgci): ESGCI DBA program for business professionals with leadership focus
- [DBA from Rushford Business School](https://www.upgrad.com/us/dba-from-rushford-business-school): Rushford Business School DBA with Dubai immersion and specializations
- [Master's in Business Management & Technology from PSB](https://www.upgrad.com/us/masters-in-business-management-and-technology-from-psb): Paris School of Business Master's in Business Management & Technology
